thread:
maria: quick brain dump — proposal for a lease-style token that runtimes can validate locally. goal: let hosted/dedicated/private interop without outbound validation calls so private installs (air-gapped) can honor routing decisions.
aj: interest check — do we want this to replace probes entirely or be an opt-in path for cross-mode routing?
kevin: prefer opt-in initially. keep probes for health checks. new "lease-token" is for authz/routing decisions only. runtime verifies signature + claims.
sara: revocation is the trickiest bit. ideas: 1) very short lifetimes (e.g., 15s) + cheap renew, 2) signed tokens plus push-based revocation lists via config-sync, 3) escrowed revocation where runtime consults local revocation view that is eventually consistent.
maria: also considered a "heartbeat-refresh" where runtime can attempt an authenticated refresh but falls back to TTL acceptance when control plane unreachable (private).
kevin: we should include an explicit "scopes" claim so token can't be reused for other actions (e.g., batch vs streaming), and a nonce to mitigate replay. add minimal fields to keep token compact.
aj: telemetry: include lease_id, issuer, route_hint, project, model, issued_at, expires_at. avoid adding prompt-level data unless sampled & hashed.
sara: sample token (compact JSON, base64-signed):
```
{"lease_id":"Lk9z9","iss":"cp-2","proj":"ingest","mdl":"rwd-3b-q","scopes":["infer"],"iat":1700000000,"exp":1700000015,"route":"dedicated-east-2","nonce":"n-42"}
```
maria: verification flow: runtime loads trusted public key from manifest/config-sync (rotate via KMS ops). verify sig, check iat/exp, check scope. if lease_id is present in local revoke-cache -> deny. if cache unavailable -> allow on TTL but emit audit event.
kevin: fallback semantics need to be deterministic: private installs should have a config flag: strict_revocation=true will always deny on unknown revocation state (for higher security tenants). default is best-effort.
aj: ops-bot please list infra tasks.
infra-bot: - add signer endpoint + HSM/KMS rotation docs
- implement lease format + stable schema v1
- add lease verifier lib to runtime repos (go/rust/python)
- add config-sync channel for public keys + revoke-cache snapshots
- instrument console to map lease_id -> route decision + reason codes
- perf test TTL renew traffic at 1k/rtps across sample tenants
sara: rollout plan: 1) spec + verifier library, 2) runtime accepts both probe and lease-token behind flag, 3) announce to select customers for beta, 4) enable default in next major.
maria: tradeoffs to capture in short RFC: perf impact (renew rate vs TTL), revocation latency model, operational complexity for private installs, key rotation story, observability for debugging route mismatches.
kevin: decent. one more: we should add a "fallback_route" claim so client control plane can suggest where to route if lease validation fails (for graceful degradation).
aj: :thumbsup: can you add a tiny example verifier snippet for the RFC?
maria: will do — i'll include pseudo-code and edge cases (clock skew, replay, key rollover). dropping draft to #rfc later today.
